intro: Many feelings «come to you»: what causes them is the subject and you are «me», «te» or «le».
p.me da vergüenza.consejo: What causes the shame is the action or thing. «Vergüenza» is written with a diaeresis: the «ü» sounds «gw».
p.me da miedo.consejo: With «dar» more feelings work: «me da pena», «me da rabia», «me da risa».
p.me pone nervioso.consejo: The adjective agrees with you: «me pone nerviosa» if you are a woman speaking.
p.me alegra.consejo: It works like «gustar»: what gladdens is the subject. «Me alegran tus noticias».
p.me molesta.consejo: The verb agrees with what bothers you: «me molesta el ruido», «me molestan los gritos».
p.me preocupa.consejo: It is used like «molestar»: «me preocupa el examen», «me preocupan las notas».
p.la entrevista.consejo: It is feminine. The «v» sounds like a «b»: «en-tre-BIS-ta».
p.el examen.consejo: It is masculine. In the plural an accent mark appears: «los exámenes».
p.suspender.consejo: That is how it is said in Spain. The opposite is «aprobar». In Latin America you also hear «reprobar».
p.en público.consejo: It is written as two words and does not change. The opposite is «en privado».
p.tranquilo.consejo: It changes with the person: «tranquilo» (he), «tranquila» (she). It also cheers someone up: «¡Tranquilo!».
b1.texto:
In Spanish, you do not «do» many feelings: they **come to you**. What causes them is the **subject**, and you are **me**, **te**, **le**, **nos**, **os** or **les**.

- **Me da vergüenza** hablar en público.
- **Me pone nerviosa** la entrevista. The adjective agrees with the person who feels.
- **Me alegra**, **me molesta**, **me preocupa** + infinitive or noun.

If what causes the feeling is plural, so is the verb: **me molestan** los ruidos.

When the subject changes you use **que** + subjunctive: **Me alegra que vengas**. For now the infinitive is enough.
b2.f0.texto: Tomorrow I have a job interview.
b2.f4.texto: Waiting in an empty room bothers me.
b2.f5.texto: Breathe deeply and think about nice things.
b2.f6.texto: I'm glad to have a friend like you.
b4.titulo: Three ways to say what you feel
b4.texto:
There are three very common structures:

- **dar** + feeling: **me da** vergüenza, miedo, pena, rabia, risa.
- **poner** + adjective: **me pone** nervioso, triste, contento.
- a feeling verb: **me alegra**, **me molesta**, **me preocupa**, **me aburre**, **me sorprende**.

In all three, what causes the feeling is the **subject**: an action in the infinitive or a thing. If it is plural, the verb is plural: **me ponen nervioso** los exámenes.
b4.e0.texto: Oral exams make me very nervous.
b4.e1.texto: The noise from the street bothers me.
b4.e2.texto: Travelling alone does not frighten me.
b5.f0.texto: Lucía waits in a long corridor with her cold hands on her knees.
b5.f1.texto: A wall clock marks the seconds with a dry tick.
b5.f2.texto: Fear rises slowly through her stomach.
b5.f3.texto: From the window comes an intense smell of freshly made coffee.
b5.f4.texto: She breathes deeply and closes her eyes for a moment.
b5.f5.texto: A kind voice says her name from the back of the room.
b5.f6.texto: Lucía gets up, smooths her shirt and walks towards the door.
b5.f7.texto: Two people greet her with a calm smile behind the table.
b5.f8.texto: Her nerves melt little by little like sugar in hot water.
b5.f9.texto: Lucía discovers with surprise that she is no longer afraid.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «dar vergüenza», like «dar miedo» or «dar pena».
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Poner» goes with an adjective: «me pone nervioso», not with «vergüenza».
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Tiene» does not fit: the structure is «me da» + feeling.
b7.o0.refuerzo: That is the masculine. You are a woman speaking: the adjective agrees with you.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Correct: it agrees with the person who feels, even though the subject is «la entrevista».
b7.o2.refuerzo: That is plural, and you are one person.
b7.pregunta: You are a woman. How does «La entrevista me pone…» end?
b8.frase: Hablar en público me da vergüenza
b9.o0.refuerzo: «Los ruidos» is plural: the verb must be «molestan».
b9.o1.refuerzo: That would mean I am causing the problem. It is not what you want to say.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Well done! The verb agrees with what bothers you.
b10.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «The exam frightens me.»
b11.o0.refuerzo: It is singular and «las noticias» is plural.
b11.o1.refuerzo: Yes: the verb agrees with what gladdens, «las noticias».
b11.o2.refuerzo: «Alegro» would be «I gladden others». Here the news is what gladdens.
b11.pregunta: There are several pieces of news. Which verb is missing?
b12.o0.refuerzo: That's it: «preocupar» is to feel uneasy about something.
b12.o1.refuerzo: Joy would be «me alegra». «Preocupa» is the opposite.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Boredom would be «me aburre». Here there is uneasiness.
b12.pregunta: Someone says «Me preocupa llegar tarde». What do they feel?
p.nerviosa.consejo: It is the feminine of «nervioso». It agrees with the person who feels nervous.
p.desconocidos.consejo: It is the plural of «el desconocido». For women: «las desconocidas».
p.esperar.consejo: It also means «to hope». To wait for a person it takes «a»: «esperar a Ana».
p.bonitas.consejo: It is the feminine plural of «bonito». Here it describes «cosas».
p.siento.consejo: It comes from «sentirse»: the «e» becomes «ie» in «me siento», «te sientes».
p.exámenes.consejo: It is the plural of «el examen»: the accent mark appears to keep the stress.
p.orales.consejo: It is the plural of «oral»; it has no feminine form: «una prueba oral».
p.ponen.consejo: With «poner» + adjective it means «to make»: «me ponen nervioso». It agrees with the cause.
p.solo.consejo: Here it is an adjective: «viajar solo» (a woman says «sola»). It no longer needs an accent mark.
p.rodillas.consejo: It is feminine: «la rodilla». The «ll» sounds like «y».
p.segundos.consejo: It is the plural of «el segundo». It is also an ordinal: «el segundo piso».
p.intenso.consejo: It changes with gender: «intenso», «intensa». It also describes colours and feelings.
p.alisa.consejo: It comes from «alisar», a regular verb, from «liso» (smooth).
p.saludan.consejo: With «la saludan», «la» is the person greeted: «la» = ella.
p.nervios.consejo: It is plural: «los nervios». «Tener nervios» means to feel nervous.
p.deshacen.consejo: It comes from «deshacer», like «hacer». «Se deshacen» means they melt away.
p.vergüenza.consejo: The diaeresis «ü» makes the «u» sound: «gwen». Without it, «gue» would be «ge».
p.molestan.consejo: In «me molestan los ruidos» the verb agrees with «los ruidos», the cause.
p.ruidos.consejo: It is the plural of «el ruido». The «ui» is one syllable, and the initial «r» is strong.
p.alegran.consejo: In «me alegran las noticias» it agrees with the plural cause, «las noticias».
p.inquietud.consejo: It ends in -d and is feminine: «la inquietud». The «qu» sounds «k».
